pick.headline: Ramzi Yousef arrested in Pakistan
pick.summary: On 7 February 1995 Ramzi Yousef, wanted for the 1993 World Trade Center bombing, was arrested in Islamabad by Pakistani agents and US officials and flown to the United States.
pick.significance: His capture followed a tip from an informant and a worldwide manhunt. It was an early case of rendering a terrorism suspect to the US for trial.

alternates.headline: Jean-Claude Duvalier flees Haiti
alternates.summary: On 7 February 1986 Haitian dictator Jean-Claude Duvalier fled to France aboard a US Air Force plane after weeks of protest.
alternates.significance: The fall of 'Baby Doc' ended 29 years of Duvalier family rule in Haiti but began years of military-dominated instability.

alternates.headline: Soviet Communist Party gives up its monopoly
alternates.summary: On 7 February 1990 the CPSU Central Committee agreed to give up the party's constitutional monopoly on power under Article 6 of the Soviet constitution.
alternates.significance: The decision opened the way to a multiparty system and marked a decisive step in the unravelling of Communist rule in the USSR.
